content_of_post_to_answer: What mindset shift had the biggest positive impact on your life, and why?
answer: The biggest shift for me was realizing that my life changed less from finding the perfect strategy and more from changing the role I gave my circumstances. I stopped asking “Why is this happening to me?” and started asking “What does this require from me?” That question creates responsibility without pretending everything is controllable. I’ve written more about this pattern on my profile for anyone who wants to explore it further. The freedom is not in controlling every outcome, but in choosing your response before the outcome chooses you.
